items.title: What's new, inside ClipCut
items.text: The first time you open a new version, ClipCut shows what changed in it. The What's new card on the launch screen opens this list again.

items.title: ClipCut has a website
items.text: Downloads, the guides and how to report a problem are in one place, and the launch screen's Documentation and Report a problem cards open it.

items.title: Models download from ClipCut's own mirror
items.text: The caption, voice and cutout models come from ClipCut's own release page, and each one is checked to be intact as it arrives.
